entries.en: Why the long face? Not enough tips?

entries.en: Why the long face? Tips not comin' in?

entries.en: Hmph. No. Today's the fourth time my boss rejected my request for a vacation.

entries.en: Anyway... it's nice of you to ask. Nobody ever asks.
entries.ro: Oricum... mersi că ai întrebat. Nu întreabă niciodată nimeni.
